fields.purpose: Partition private usage and quota evidence for one provider account inside one anonymous central participant.
fields.allowedValues: unattributed or account-track:v1 followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
fields.limitations: Not cross-device continuity, authentication, ownership proof, unique-person proof, eligibility, or anti-Sybil evidence.

fields.purpose: Bind contribution parts to one immutable locally reviewed dataset without authenticating a participant.
fields.limitations: Completeness still requires exact part-count and covered-interval validation.

fields.purpose: Order a bounded contribution inside one complete dataset.
fields.limitations: An index cannot establish completeness without the matching immutable dataset contract.

fields.purpose: Declare the exact number of bounded contributions in one dataset.
fields.limitations: The server must observe every unique part before treating the dataset as complete.

fields.purpose: Prevent partial uploads from producing calibrated allowance estimates.
fields.limitations: Client complete is a claim until server set reconciliation passes.

fields.purpose: Require an explicit renewed account-track disclosure before any future v0.2 upload.
fields.limitations: The disabled draft is not presentable for acceptance.
